```{=html}
<div class="fi-invite">
  <img id="fi-invite-photo" class="fi-invite-photo" alt="" referrerpolicy="no-referrer" hidden>
  <p id="fi-invite-detail" class="fi-invite-detail" hidden></p>
  <p class="fi-invite-lead">Understand nutrition, find recipes, plan meals, and eat a little healthier with less effort.</p>
  <ul class="fi-invite-list">
    <li>Look up or scan any food to see how five expert rating systems score it.</li>
    <li>Import a recipe from TikTok, a website or a photo, and make it healthier one change at a time.</li>
    <li>Plan your week's dinners and get a grocery list.</li>
    <li>Build your diet signature and watch it grow as you make healthier choices.</li>
  </ul>

  <div class="fi-invite-actions">
    <a id="fi-invite-get" class="fi-invite-btn" href="#" hidden>Get FRESH</a>
  </div>
  <p id="fi-invite-testflight" class="fi-invite-note" hidden>You'll install TestFlight first, Apple's app for trying new apps.</p>
  <p id="fi-invite-soon" class="fi-invite-note">FRESH is in a free test release on iPhone. The install link will be on this page soon.</p>

  <p id="fi-invite-have" class="fi-invite-note">Already have FRESH? <a id="fi-invite-open" href="fresh://invite">Open your invite</a><span id="fi-invite-code-line" hidden>, or tap your initial at the top of FRESH and choose Enter an invite code: <strong id="fi-invite-code"></strong></span></p>

  <p class="fi-invite-note">Accepting connects your account to your friend's. Nothing is shared between you yet.</p>
</div>

<script>
(function () {
  // The public TestFlight link, set once Apple approves the external test group; App Store link later.
  var INSTALL_URL = "https://testflight.apple.com/join/y43wSsGn";
  var raw = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get("code") || "";
  var code = raw.replace(/[^A-Za-z0-9-]/g, "").slice(0, 32);
  var from = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get("from") || "";
  if (["home", "plan", "groceries", "recipe", "household"].indexOf(from) === -1) from = "";
  // The sender's first name rides on the link (the app's text message puts it there); shown only as a greeting.
  var by = (new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get("by") || "").replace(/[^A-Za-zÀ-ɏ' -]/g, "").trim().slice(0, 30);
  // What was shared (a recipe's photo and title, or a plan's name and dinners). The Worker that serves this page
  // puts the same card the link preview shows in #fi-invite-preview-data; served straight from the site, the page
  // asks the Worker for it. A general invite has none, and the page stays as it is.
  var PREVIEW_API = "https://fresh-insights-engage.freshfoodrecs.workers.dev/api/invite/preview";
  var inline = document.getElementById("fi-invite-preview-data");
  var card = null;
  try { card = inline ? JSON.parse(inline.textContent) : null; } catch (e) { card = null; }
  if (by && !card) document.querySelector("h1.title").textContent = by + " invited you to FRESH";
  function showPreview(c) {
    if (!c || (c.kind !== "recipe" && c.kind !== "plan") || typeof c.title !== "string" || typeof c.description !== "string") return;
    document.querySelector("h1.title").textContent = c.title;
    var detail = document.getElementById("fi-invite-detail");
    detail.textContent = c.description;
    detail.hidden = false;
    if (c.kind === "recipe" && c.photo === true && /^https:\/\//.test(c.image)) {
      var photo = document.getElementById("fi-invite-photo");
      photo.alt = c.description;
      photo.onload = function () { photo.hidden = false; document.getElementById("fi-invite-mark-img").hidden = true; };
      photo.src = c.image;
    }
  }
  if (card) showPreview(card);
  else if (code && window.fetch) {
    fetch(PREVIEW_API + "?code=" + encodeURIComponent(code))
      .then(function (r) { return r.ok ? r.json() : null; })
      .then(function (d) { if (d) showPreview(d.preview); })
      .catch(function () { /* the general invite stays */ });
  }
  var open = document.getElementById("fi-invite-open");
  if (code) {
    open.href = "fresh://invite?code=" + encodeURIComponent(code) + (from ? "&from=" + from : "") + (by ? "&by=" + encodeURIComponent(by) : "");
    document.getElementById("fi-invite-code").textContent = code;
    document.getElementById("fi-invite-code-line").hidden = false;
  }
  if (INSTALL_URL) {
    var get = document.getElementById("fi-invite-get");
    get.href = INSTALL_URL;
    // Carry the invite through the install: the app reads this once on its first launch (fresh_app, feat/invite-clipboard).
    get.addEventListener("click", function () {
      if (!code || !navigator.clipboard) return;
      var text = "FRESH invite " + code + (from ? " from=" + from : "") + (by ? " by=" + encodeURIComponent(by) : "");
      try { navigator.clipboard.writeText(text); } catch (e) { /* the code is still on this page */ }
    });
    get.hidden = false;
    document.getElementById("fi-invite-testflight").hidden = false;
    document.getElementById("fi-invite-soon").hidden = true;
  }
})();
</script>
```
